name: @hasna/secrets
description: A local secrets vault for AI agents — store API keys, passwords, tokens, and any credentials

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/status.ts src/storage.ts src/security.ts src/loop-tasks.ts src/mcp-server.ts src/sdk.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external pg --external @aws-sdk/* --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --format esm --external pg --external @aws-sdk/* --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && chmod +x dist/index.js dist/mcp-server.js dist/server/index.js && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist

author: hasna
